messages.content: Why was insulin sent to H2?

H2 has a shortage of 15 vials of Insulin Human 40IU/ml. W0 holds lot B-IN-2026-001 with 50 vials expiring 2027-01-31. After accounting for transit time (0.4h) and H2's existing stock, 28 vials are usable before expiry at H2's consumption rate of 0.5 vials/day. The cold chain route W0→H2 is available with vehicle Cold Van Alpha.
